## Monday morning report

Pulls last week's numbers from all three networks plus the CRM, has Claude write a short readout, and emails it.

### The part that is not cosmetic

The **token health check** runs in the same pass. Facebook page tokens expire, and the failure mode is silent — posts stop going out and nobody notices for a fortnight. If the token has under 14 days left, the report says so in the subject line.

Use a Business Manager **System User** token to avoid the 60-day expiry entirely; this check is the backstop either way.
